scores.evidence: The lesson uses です・ます throughout and has no pressure phrases. Sentences are short and warm (hook-b1, s4-enforce, summary-next), and lint --strict is clean. The round-1 breaks are gone. There are no half-width spaces between 和文 and English (「Claude Codeに」「CIで」「JSONで」), the card backs now use です・ます (summary-cards), and s1-defs now parses (「Ctrl + B で裏に回し、セッションごと裏で始めるなら `claude --bg` を使います」). A few phrases are still stiff: the s3-table header 「役割と、付けないと」 and the section 5 title 「依頼文の4点で点検する」.

measure.mjs reports prose 1521 (budget 1,200–2,400), read 2645, practice reading 1247, 11 questions and est 20.0 min. That is at the 20-minute cap, and estMinutes is 20. Splitting the old section 4 into unattended-where and unattended eases the table-heavy screen. Every concept section is followed by an inline check within 2 sections. Sentence and paragraph budgets hold. The est is at the upper limit, so adding text here would break the time budget.

The round-1 gaps are closed. CI is spelled out in s3-lead, チェックアウト is gone, エージェントビュー（agent view） has its English, 試験公開中 replaces リサーチプレビュー, cron becomes 「決まった時刻」, VM becomes 「仮想マシン（VM）」, and PR becomes 「PR（プルリクエスト）」. Two katakana terms still appear for the first time in the course without English: トークン (s1-cost, e1) and シェル (s3-pitfall, e3). Both fixes are in mustFix.

The single declared locale (jp) is complete, with no plain-string or untranslated findings. The one link names its destination: 「公式ドキュメント（非対話的実行）」 in s3-mode. There are no images or diagrams with embedded text. Plain-text fields such as the checklist labels and var hints contain no markdown.

summary: The scope check required a full review (exit 1: new section unattended-where, o2 changed, 57% of parts and 86% of blocks changed). I checked all 9 round-1 must-fix items and every one is gone. Spaces between 和文 and English are removed, s1-defs now parses, and CI, VM and PR are spelled out. チェックアウト and cron were replaced with plain words, エージェントビュー（agent view） has its English with 試験公開中, s4-table states 「間隔は最短…」, and the card backs use です・ます. Two new first-use katakana terms without English still block the review: トークン (s1-cost) and シェル (s3-pitfall). measure.mjs gives prose 1521 and est 20.0 min, at the cap, so fixes should not add length. With the two mustFix items applied and voice or load lifted slightly (e.g. the s3-table header and section 5 title in niceToHave), the lesson can pass.
